item: A3. Henan Xingyang Feilongding: what is built
proposal: fix('CHN', 'Henan Xingyang Feilongding wind farm', G, '容量改為 32.4 MW：鄭州市政府 2022 年列滎陽市飛龍頂風電場已建成 32.4 MW；新天綠能 2020 年招股書列核准容量 48.6 MW（2019 年底在建），2021 年對滎陽新天的在建工程提列減值（可收回金額小於帳面價值），這筆減值到 2023 年底仍在帳上，其餘部分看來沒有完工。GEM 的 49.5 MW 是核准規模；商轉年未查到', 'Capacity set to 32.4 MW: Zhengzhou’s government listed the Xingyang Feilongding wind farm as built with 32.4 MW in 2022; Suntien Green Energy’s 2020 prospectus gives the approved size as 48.6 MW (under construction at the end of 2019), and in 2021 Suntien impaired the construction in progress of Xingyang Suntien (recoverable amount below book value), an impairment still on the books at the end of 2023, so the rest appears not to have been completed. GEM’s 49.5 MW is the approved size; the commissioning year was not found', 'https://public.zhengzhou.gov.cn/D1102X/6715242.jhtml', mw=32.4, note=True)
note_zh: 鄭州市 2022 年列已建成 32.4 MW；新天綠能核准 48.6 MW，2021 年提列的滎陽新天在建工程減值到 2023 年底仍在帳上；新天綠能年報的華中地區（河南、湖北、湖南）控股容量 2022、2023、2025 年都是 156.2 MW，2022 年後沒有再增加。商轉年仍不明（2020 年年報飛龍頂在建工程進度 92.59%、尚未轉固）。
note_en: Zhengzhou (2022) counts 32.4 MW built; Suntien’s approval was 48.6 MW and the 2021 impairment of Xingyang Suntien’s construction in progress is still carried at the end of 2023; Suntien’s controlled capacity in Central China (Henan, Hubei, Hunan) is 156.2 MW in its 2022, 2023 and 2025 reports, so nothing was added there after 2022. The year is still unknown (the 2020 report shows the Feilongding works at 92.59% of budget, not yet transferred to fixed assets).
why: Capacity rests on the Zhengzhou industry bureau (official) plus the Suntien filings; the year is not written. Weihui Dongshuanma (Suntien’s other Henan farm) was connected in 2020, so the Henan total of 64.2 MW at end-2020 cannot be split between the two farms without guessing.

why: chnenergybidding.com.cn (403/503), wind.imarine.cn (403) and bjx (captcha) unreadable, so the CHN Energy project’s site and status could not be confirmed. Leaning: separate project (keep).

note_zh: Baldota 集團（MSPL 與 RMML）風電頁只列一座 Harapanahalli（Sogi & Jajikalgudda）風場，七座合計 215.75 MW（同頁另寫 230.1 MW）；本站 MSPL 的紀錄（GR Halli 41、Sogi & Jajikallgudda 106、Surajbari 30、Dhule 20、Tinwari 10 MW，加 Harihar 6.6 MW）已約 214 MW，再加 RMML 的 Sogi 50 MW 會超過集團總量，表示 Sogi 很可能已含在 106 MW 裡，但只是加總推論。
note_en: The Baldota group’s wind page (MSPL and RMML) lists a single Harapanahalli (Sogi & Jajikalgudda) farm among seven totalling 215.75 MW (230.1 MW elsewhere on the page); the site’s MSPL rows (GR Halli 41, Sogi & Jajikallgudda 106, Surajbari 30, Dhule 20, Tinwari 10 MW, plus Harihar 6.6 MW) already make about 214 MW, so adding RMML’s Sogi 50 MW would exceed the group total: Sogi is probably inside the 106 MW, but this is arithmetic only.
why: No per-farm capacity on Baldota’s pages; Baldota’s 2015 report only via web.archive.org (403 here). A dup needs a source giving the Harapanahalli farm’s capacity by company.

item: C. PTC Energy’s five farms: years
proposal: (no change yet; same for Devenkonda, Molagavalli (PTC), Kandimallayapalli, Payalakuntla)
note_zh: PTC India 2016–17 年報（BSE 公開 PDF）：五座風場合計 238.8 MW 於 2016–17 財年「依約定時程在 2017-03-31 前商轉」，沒有逐場日期；2017–18 年報的借款表寫出機組廠商（Devenkonda ReGen 49.5 MW、Bableshwar Gamesa 50 MW）。年份仍是 2016 或 2017。另注意：Hero 的 Bableshwar（50 MW，25 部 Gamesa G114，2017-03）與 PTC 的 Bableshwar（50 MW Gamesa）同村同規模，可能是同一 Gamesa 園區的兩塊，未查證。
note_en: PTC India’s 2016–17 annual report (public BSE PDF): the five farms (238.8 MW) were commissioned in fiscal 2016–17 “as per the agreed schedule by 31.03.2017”, with no per-farm dates; the 2017–18 report’s loan notes give the OEMs (Devenkonda ReGen 49.5 MW, Bableshwar Gamesa 50 MW). The year is still 2016 or 2017. Note: Hero’s Bableshwar (50 MW, 25 Gamesa G114, March 2017) and PTC’s Bableshwar (50 MW Gamesa) share village and size; they may be two blocks of one Gamesa park, unchecked.
why: Per-project CODs would need APERC/KERC PPA orders or the AP High Court tariff judgments (not reached this round); ptcindia.com fails TLS. BSE annual-report PDFs (bseindia.com/bseplus/AnnualReport/532524/…) are a new working route.
